profile.purpose: Maintain House Tang military personnel at the highest sustainable field-ready standard through demanding relevant practice. Training credit requires real attendance, qualified instruction or valid self-practice, suitable equipment and facilities, health, recovery, relevance, and difficulty fit; time spent exhausted or repeating mastered material without useful difficulty is not full-quality training.
